Name: repro_nanabanana2_tool_augmented_image_gen
Title: Reproducing NanoBananba-2-Style Tool-Augmented Image Generation/Editing with Qwen-Image
Short Hypothesis: If we (1) use a strong tool-using VLM/agent (e.g., Gemini with built-in web search / image search / external API calls) to enrich user prompts with up-to-date world knowledge and retrieved reference images, then (2) pass the enriched context into an open image model (Qwen-Image for T2I or image-edit), we can reproduce a large fraction of NanoBananba-2-style 'world-aware' photorealistic generations and context-grounded edits compared to a no-tools baseline.
Related Work: Recent product demos (e.g., 'Window Seat'-style experiences) combine an agent's tool use (web + live weather + location) with image generation to produce photorealistic, context-grounded imagery. This idea tests whether similar results can be reproduced by separating (A) tool orchestration / retrieval (Gemini) from (B) image synthesis (Qwen-Image), and optionally replacing the orchestrator with a small local Qwen model.

models: Gemini API (orchestrator; tool use/web search/image search) Look up latest doc on how to get Gemini to do so
Gemini 'nano bananba 2' image model (baseline/reference, via Gemini API)
Qwen-Image (latest HF checkpoint; local inference on RTX 5080) for text-to-image and/or image editing
Optional: small local Qwen LLM for orchestration (if tool setup is feasible)
tasks: Tool-augmented text-to-image: generate images from prompts requiring live external facts (weather, locations, events) after tool enrichment
Tool-augmented image editing: retrieve an appropriate reference image (e.g., a specific character/person) and edit it to match the enriched context
prompt_suite: World/location + live weather prompts (e.g., photorealistic window views inspired by a real place with current conditions)
Reference-image retrieval prompts (e.g., 'anime character in a specific pose' where the image model may not know the character without a retrieved image)
conditions: (A) No-tools baseline: direct prompt to image model
(B) Gemini-enriched context: Gemini performs tool calls, returns enriched context -> image model generates/edits
(C) Full agent loop (optional): orchestrator iterates tool calls + generation + refinement
tools_and_dependencies: Maybe code execution? if we could come up with such use cases, that only code need to solve this
Web image search / reverse image search (Gemini tool or external API key)
resources: Gemini AI Studio / Gemini API access for orchestration and nano bananba 2 baseline calls
RTX 5080 for local Qwen-Image / Qwen-Image-Edit inference

evaluation.human_vibe_check: Manual inspection of generated/edited images for correctness and faithfulness to retrieved context.
evaluation.vlm_judge: Use a VLM judge prompt (e.g., gemini-3-1-pro-preview) to score whether the output image matches the expected grounded attributes from the enriched context.
suggested_metrics: Grounded-attribute accuracy (does the image reflect retrieved facts like weather/location-specific cues?)
Edit faithfulness (does the edit preserve identity/reference while applying the requested changes?)
Hallucination rate (visual claims not supported by retrieved context)

notes: Start with Gemini as orchestrator to reduce tool-integration complexity (built-in web search/tool use).
Once the pipeline works with nano bananba 2 as the image model, swap in local Qwen-Image to isolate image-model dependence.
If results are strong, try replacing Gemini orchestration with a small local Qwen LLM + explicit tool wrappers.
